wah.translation: abbr. 在家工作（Work at Home）；哇音效果器

wah-wah.translation: n. （铜管乐器开或闭所发出的）哇音；（电子乐器, 尤指电吉他的）哇音

wahabee.definition:
n. A follower of Abdel Wahab (b. 1691; d. 1787), a reformer
   of Mohammedanism. His doctrines prevail particularly among the
   Bedouins, and the sect, though checked in its influence, extends to
   most parts of Arabia, and also into India.
wahabee.translation: n. （伊斯兰教）瓦哈比教派的教徒

wahabi.definition: n a member of a strictly orthodox Sunni Muslim sect from Saudi Arabia; strives to purify Islamic beliefs and rejects any innovation occurring after the 3rd century of Islam
wahabi.translation: （伊斯兰教）瓦哈比教派的教徒

wahabism.translation: [网络] 瓦哈比主义；极端主义

wahhabi.definition: n. a member of a strictly orthodox Sunni Muslim sect from Saudi Arabia; strives to purify Islamic beliefs and rejects any innovation occurring after the 3rd century of Islam
wahhabi.translation: n. (伊斯兰教)瓦哈比教派的教徒

wahhabism.definition: n a conservative and intolerant form of Islam that is practiced in Saudi Arabia
wahhabism.translation: n. (伊斯兰教)瓦哈比教派的教义和习俗

wahine.translation: n. (夏威夷)玻利尼西亚妇女, 太太

wahl.translation: [人名] 沃尔; [地名] [卢森堡] 瓦尔

wahoo.definition:
n. deciduous shrub having purple capsules enclosing scarlet seeds
n. large fast-moving predacious food and game fish; found worldwide
